    1. Home/
    2. Common questions

    Common questions

    Transport

    Is there parking on campus?

    Parking inside the university is reserved for master's students and university staff only.

    Students in any year may bring a car onto campus from 16:30 onwards.

    The nearest parking for undergraduates is Sanam Luang (free) or Wat Mahathat (paid).

    Welfare

    Where do I apply to defer my tuition fees?

    Apply to your faculty. Each request is considered individually.

    I lost my student card: what do I do?

    First, ask TUSU Tha Prachan to post it as Lost & Found.

    If it does not turn up, freeze the account through the Bangkok Bank app and then go to the Bangkok Bank branch by the Tha Prachan gate.

    Which app does every TU student need?

    TU Greats App.

    What is TU Virtual Clinic?

    TU Virtual Clinic is the campus sick bay, on the health courtyard under the Student Activity Building, opposite the gym.

    Open Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 16:30.

    Bring your student card and your ID card, or your passport if you are an international student.

    Where can I talk to a psychologist?

    Book through the TU Greats App and choose the TU Well Being service.

    Appointments are on the 3rd floor, Student Affairs Division office, Student Activity Building.

    The phone line runs 24 hours: call 02-026-2345 and press 2.

    Where is the defibrillator (AED)?

    In front of the Sri Burapha Auditorium.

    Where are the prayer rooms?

    There are three.

    • In front of the gymnasium
    • Faculty of Liberal Arts, 6th floor
    • Pridi Banomyong Library, level U1
    When is the fitness centre open?

    Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 20:00.

    Activities

    Where can I borrow sports equipment?

    From your own faculty, or from the TUSU Tha Prachan room on the 2nd floor of the Student Activity Building. Bring your student card.

    How do I book a room in the Student Activity Building or the gym?

    Book at https://sa.tu.ac.th/oth/SATU_booking/MENU_booking/ and attach the completed request form.

    Governance

    Where can I make a complaint?

    For anything about course registration, contact your faculty and the Office of the Registrar.

    To complain to TUSU Tha Prachan, use the link in the bio on any of TUSU's social media profiles.

    Why should I contact my own faculty committee before taking something to TUSU?

    For general questions you can ask TUSU directly.

    For anything about course content, anything involving a fee, or anything specific to one faculty, contact your own faculty: each faculty and programme has its own limits and curriculum conditions.

    If I withdraw from a course, where do I get the refund?

    The refund is paid into your Bangkok Bank account.

    Where do I apply for a credit exemption?

    Apply through the faculty you belong to. The application window differs by faculty, so ask your faculty for the dates.

    What happens if I withdraw from a course after the add/drop period?

    TU Greats shows a W against that course. It does not affect your academic result, but the fee cannot be refunded under any circumstances.
